name: inspira-wavy-background
title: Wavy Background
blurb: Layered undulating waves with Simplex noise, flowing smoothly across the screen.
description: Canvas-based animated waves using Simplex noise for organic motion. Multiple coloured layers create depth with customizable speed, opacity, and blur.
use_when: A fluid, organic-feeling background for hero sections with a modern, flowing aesthetic.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — continuous canvas animation with Simplex noise is computationally intensive.
a11y: Wrapper component with content slot; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid children. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
